svg.title: Quality-gated knowledge publication
svg.desc: Separate data refinement, governance assessment and an explicitly owned publication gate before AI retrieval. Purview assesses configured quality rules. Blocking publication and quarantining data are explicit pipeline responsibilities, not an automatic Purview side effect.

text.tspan: Optional Fabric + Purview reference | REFERENCE DESIGN - NOT DEPLOYED
Microsoft Fabric / OneLake - separate refinement layers
Governance, enforcement and consumption are different responsibilities
Solid: primary flow / semantic relationship Dashed: supporting evidence, control or return
Public Microsoft sources: MS09, MS10, MS11, MS12, MS13 | See companion documentation for scope and exclusions.
